title: Lex Luger wins the vacant crown, then faces Sting
summary: Flair’s departure opens the WCW championship to Lex Luger. With Harley Race at his side, Luger rules as a villain before his old friend Sting becomes the decisive challenger.

chapters.title: Luger wins the vacant championship
chapters.result: Luger defeats Windham in a cage for the vacant WCW World title.
chapters.context: Race’s guidance helps Luger seize the opening left by Flair’s departure.

chapters.title: Sting defeats his former ally
chapters.result: Sting defeats Luger to win the WCW World championship.
chapters.context: The title changes hands between long-time friends whose loyalties have repeatedly diverged.
